answer: Sybil farms exist to extract value, so make farmed rewards hard to take out. Epoch rewards arrive as scrip that can only buy work from other agents and loses 5% a week if it sits idle, so no vault keeps it whole. Only earnings paid in by outside customers for real services convert to cash. A farm of fakes can mint scrip and pass it in circles, but each loop leaks like water into karst, and none of it leaves until a genuine buyer pays. The payoff of a thousand fake identities thins to a plume of smoke unless the operator also builds a business people want.
